subject: Multi-year prepay: redlines to early-termination & co-terming (Maple Health)
messages:
From: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@maplehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@maplehealth.com>, procurement <procurement@maplehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — 3yr prepay + onboarding plan

Jonas — thanks for the proposal. Team is excited about the 3-year prepay economics but legal has pushed back on the refund and early-termination language in the SOW. I attached the redlines (Maple_SOW_v3.pdf) — high level asks are:

- No unlimited refunds: they want a capped refund schedule (we proposed full pro-rata today).
- Stronger co-term protections: they want the ability to align Redwood payment schedule to their calendar year without penalty.
- Early termination notice: 90 days + cure period.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can agree to a capped refund (they suggested 50% of remaining prepay) and what impact that has on the effective term discount? Also we prefer the DocuSign route once redlines are agreed.

Thanks,
Aditi
--
Aditi Shah
Head of Platform Partnerships
Maple Health Systems
From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@maplehealth.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@maplehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — 3yr prepay + onboarding plan

Aditi — appreciate the quick read. Quick answers up front: we can work toward a capped refund but the cap materially changes the economics; we need to model the impact and propose a break/cancellation fee alternative. On co-terming: we can support co-term alignment with a one-time adjustment and pro-rated invoice, but we cannot waive the minimum commitment we agreed on.

Action plan:
- I'll run a refund / break-fee model (attached pricing spreadsheet) showing net effective discount under a 50% cap vs. our standard pro-rata.
- Suggest a compromise: cap refund at 50% of remaining prepay OR allow pro-rata refund minus a 6-month minimum (whichever is greater), plus a flat break fee equal to 5% of remaining committed ARR. That preserves predictability on both sides.
- For co-terming, propose a one-time co-term invoice that re-aligns billing and keeps total committed spend unchanged.

Looping in Laura and Marissa for legal/finance sign-off — Laura, Marissa: can you review the proposed concession structure below and confirm whether we can accept in principle? If yes, I'll send a tracked redline back to Aditi.

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — 3yr prepay + onboarding plan

Jonas — reviewed. Finance and Legal notes: we can accept the 50% cap OR the pro-rata minus a 6-month floor + 5% break fee as an either/or, but not both combined (that creates undesirable complexity). Prefer to present the single simpler option to the customer. Recommended language to send back: "Customer may elect a pro-rata refund of unused prepaid amounts subject to a six (6) month non-refundable minimum; alternatively Redwood may, at its option, provide a refund equal to fifty percent (50%) of the remaining prepaid balance if Customer elects termination without cause prior to term end. All refunds will be subject to a break fee equal to five percent (5%) of the remaining committed amount."

On co-terming: finance will allow a one-time billing adjustment to align to fiscal year provided the total committed amount across the remaining term is unchanged and the customer signs within 30 days. Document this as an amendment (no change to discount tiers).

Marissa — can you draft the tracked SOW redline using the language above and include a DocuSign envelope link placeholder? I want the pricing workbook updated to show effective discount vs. gross discount for sales to confirm.

Laura
Legal Counsel — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — 3yr prepay + onboarding plan

Thanks — draft redline attached (Maple_SOW_v3.pdf) and pricing workbook updated (Maple_pricing_model_v2.xlsx). Key points I tracked: 
- Inserted refund paragraph per Laura's recommended wording and added a 90-day notice + 30-day cure period.
- Added co-term amendment clause: one-time alignment invoice allowed if signed within thirty (30) days; co-terming does not change discount tiers.
- Clarified renewal behavior: auto-renew remains but renewals revert to standard annual prepay discount tiers unless a new multi-year prepay is signed.

If we approve, I'll upload the tracked SOW to DocuSign and include an amendment summary page that shows the effective unit economics under the two refund scenarios (50% cap vs. 6-month floor + break fee). Jonas — please confirm send-to list for the envelope.

Marissa
Sr. Manager, Commercial Contracts — Redwood Inference
From: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@maplehealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@maplehealth.com>, procurement <procurement@maplehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal — 3yr prepay + onboarding plan

Jonas / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear options. Maple leadership prefers the simpler single option: the 50% cap + 5% break fee, and the 90-day notice with 30-day cure period is acceptable. They will sign the amendment as soon as we provide the tracked SOW and a short summary showing net savings under the agreed cap (versus their original ask).

Next steps:
1) Send final tracked SOW in DocuSign to Aditi Shah + Tom Reynolds + procurement@maplehealth.com.
2) Attach the pricing workbook with a one-page summary of effective discount and monthly burn implications.
3) Once signed, schedule the co-term alignment invoice and confirm billing dates.

If you can get the DocuSign envelope out today, I will circle back with finance to book the payment.

Best,
Aditi
--
Aditi Shah
Head of Platform Partnerships
Maple Health Systems
